core.title: Waterford Lever With Premiere Rose, Weslock 7100Q

text.description_html:
Weslock Waterford Lever with Arched Premiere Rose

This Weslock solid bronze Waterford Lever With Premiere Rose has a rustic style that is sure to grant any home's decor a old world look that is both charming and simple--this insures that this lever will look great no matter how your home's furnishings change around it. It has an oil rubbed bronze finish. It is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable for either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches with removable faceplate.

This simple lever is from the Weslock Molten Bronze Collection which features easy installation, lifetime mechanical and finish warranties, and meets ANSI grade 2 lock standards.

Features of the Weslock Waterford Lever With Premiere Rose:

  • Rose and Lever Material: Solid Bronze
  • Adjustable latches include removable faceplates.
  • Removable door lever prevents scratching during installation.
  • Panic-proof privacy function - one turn of interior lever unlocks and opens door.
  • Push-button locking rosette.
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty
  • Fully ADA Compliant

Specifications of the Waterford Lever With Premiere Rose:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Lever Length: 4-3/4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Rose Style: Premiere
  • Rose Height: 5"
  • Rose Width: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplate
  • Fits doors prepared with 2-1/8" cross hole and 1" edge hole

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim. Does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latches but does not lock. Door lever operates latch from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking for privacy. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy lock; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy and retract latchbolt.

Sold Individually
